# relay_valkey_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing managed Valkey cluster in a workspace, by ID or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_valkey_cluster" "sessions" {
  workspace_id = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "sessions"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_host` (String) Public read-write endpoint host. Empty until the platform publishes it.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Public read-write endpoint port.
- `mode` (String) `replication` or `cluster`.
- `nodes` (Attributes Map) The cluster's node group, keyed by its label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `parameters` (Map of String) Valkey settings.
- `phase` (String)
- `private_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_endpoints))
- `public_endpoints` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_endpoints))
- `ready_nodes` (Number)
- `replicas_per_shard` (Number) Replicas behind each shard's primary. Null in `replication` mode.
- `shards` (Number) Primaries the keyspace is split across. Null in `replication` mode.
- `storage_status` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_status))
- `total_nodes` (Number)
- `version` (String)
